items.text: in the light theme the dice's amount ring is a dark teal on a white track, so it reads on the white bar
the notes in the update notice and under Version show their kind in words again, NEW · FIX · CHANGE, beside the icon
the share sheet asks what to make it as: still · video · GIF · sticker. A still or a sticker is remade on the spot from the stage; video and GIF step the sheet aside and start recording

a change of scene hands the water surface over like weather: the old surface's rain, wake and drops thin out and its waves calm on their own; once it is still, the new surface's look comes in, and its rain or wake starts only after the new scene has settled, a moment later, never on the cut. Turning the surface off lets it calm first; turning it on starts flat
opening "What's new" in the update notice no longer shifts or widens it when the list gets a scrollbar; every scrolling panel and list keeps room for its scrollbar, so nothing moves sideways

the update notice leads with the sparkle, and each line of What's new wears its kind: a sparkle for new, a squashed bug for a fix, two turning arrows for a change (here and under Version in the index)
the sticker preview holds still when a scene's name appears above the bar: it always sits above the name's line
on a computer the sticker preview is bigger
tap Sticker again to put the sticker away: Capture goes back to what it was before, and the preview goes
a water bed playing on its own (the stream, the surf…) lights the Sound button and shows its wave; tapping the button turns it off with the thermometer, like any other sound

the sticker's frame is a row of color chips, like the color shelf's swatches: none (diagonal lines), white, black and your own color. Press and hold any chip, or tap the last one, to mix a frame color of your own in the Color mixer

what goes under the sticker is "Extras": Brand, Text and QR are toggles, any mix of them, or none. Text writes your own words (the scene's word until you type); the QR opens this scene. They sit in one tidy tab under the sticker

while Capture is on Sticker, a live preview of the sticker floats above the bar, so you change the frame and extras while looking at it. Tap it to make the sticker: it grows into the share sheet, and shrinks back when you close it
the share sheet closes where it opened: its close button sits exactly over the Capture button, so a capture made by mistake is undone by tapping the same spot again
when the sound goes off, the circle grows back into the Sound button a shade darker: the signal is on, the sound is off
the Sound drawer's caret hides while the off thermometer runs and comes back after
the playing Sound button's level wave is dark teal again, as before the thermometer (white didn't read)
